Anritsu.why: Its Test & Measurement business sells evaluation and manufacturing-test instruments to optical transceiver makers (BERTWave MP2110A for 400GE/800GE/1.6TE modules, optical spectrum analyzer for CPO laser evaluation); AI data-center demand in the optical transceiver market drove T&M revenue +34% in Q1 FY2026.
Anritsu.evidence: Anritsu Q1 FY2026 results presentation (07-30-2026): 'In the T&M business, data center-related demand, such as in the optical transceiver market, remained strong due to the spread of AI'; Q&A: 'We have received orders for both 800GE and 1.6TE related products.'

players.product: Optical transceiver test instruments: BERTWave MP2110A (400GE/800GE/1.6TE module manufacturing test), MP1900A Signal Quality Analyzer, MS9740B optical spectrum analyzer for CPO/LD evaluation

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu results briefing Q&A summary: Financial Results of FY2026 Q1 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (Q&A): orders received for both 800GE and 1.6TE optical transceiver related T&M products, but 800GE still represents the larger share of orders

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu results briefing Q&A summary: Financial Results of FY2026 Q1 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (Q&A): Q1 T&M revenue was generally in line with expectations while orders exceeded expectations due to strong data center-related demand and some customers placing orders ahead of schedule based on their production plans; full-year forecast left unchanged as revenue was in line with plan

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu results briefing Q&A summary: Financial Results of FY2026 Q1 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (Q&A): the mobile market is expected to remain weak and largely flat for the time being; demand could begin to pick up ahead of the transition toward Pre-6G service expected around the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games, and the company is hopeful conditions start to improve from next year onward. PQA strength in North America is driven by X-ray inspection products for the meat processing market
